sentences.text:
Present :- Mr. Paramjeet Singh, Dag,
Haryana for the appellants.

Present appeal is directed against award dated 03.02.2009
passed by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Hisar whereby the appellants moved petition under
Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 seeking compensation on account of damage caused to
bus bearing registration No.HR-39/0414 in a motor vehicular accident dated 15.08.1994.

2 The Tribunal held that the accident was caused due to rash and negligent driving of respondent
No.1 and awarded compensation of Rs.8,264/- apart from cost of Rs.1,000/-.
3  The appellants by way of present appeal are seeking enhancement of compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
The primary ground for seeking enhancement is that due to accident the bus remained idle for 19 POOJA SHARMA 2026.02.05 17:16 FAQ-3122-2009 (O&M) days i.e. from 16.08.1994 to 02.09.1994.
The department suffered business loss for the said period.

4 From the perusal of the record, it is evident that though Chur Singh appeared as PW2 and claimed that the department suffered a loss of Rs.96,132/- but there was no justification behind the figure claimed.
He could not spell out how the figure was arrived at.
In these circumstances, the Tribunal by way of guess work awarded a sum of Rs.2,000/- for loss of business by bus for 19 days.

5 In the considered opinion of this Court, in the absence of any evidence to prove the actual loss, no fault can be found with the Tribunal in applying the 'guess work' and awarding compensation of Rs.2,000/-
